code:
SELECT c.customer_id,
 CASE WHEN x.cancel_date > :snap
  AND x.cancel_date <=
      date(:snap, '+60 days')
  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS churn_60d
FROM c LEFT JOIN cancellations x ...
WHERE x.cancel_date IS NULL
   OR x.cancel_date >= :snap
caption: c = distinct customers. Early cancellers are dropped.
